description: This file implements the SharedMemoryBuffer class and related functions for managing shared memory buffers, including creation, mapping, unmapping, and data management for media playback types in a server environment.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBuffer
classes.description: Manages a shared memory buffer for media data, supporting partition mapping, unmapping, and data access.

methods.name: calculatePartitionSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of partitions based on media playback type and number of partitions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts MediaPlaybackType enum to string representation.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::SharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that creates and initializes the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::~SharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::mapPartition
methods.description: Maps a partition for a given playback type and ID.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::unmapPartition
methods.description: Unmaps a partition for a given playback type and ID.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::clearData
methods.description: Clears data in a specified partition and media source type.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::getDataOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of data for a given partition and media source type.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::getMaxDataLen
methods.description: Returns the maximum data length for a partition and media source type.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::getDataPtr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data buffer for a given partition and media source type.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::getFd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::getBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the start of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::calculateBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates the total size of the shared memory buffer based on partitions.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::getDataPtrForPartition
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to the data for a specific partition and playback type.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::getPlaybackTypePartition
methods.description: Returns the vector of partitions for a given playback type.
